name.zh: 稳定刷取，还是继续推进

summary.zh: 下一关更诱人，但当前目标可能更适合积累下一次突破的资源。
summary.en: The next stage is tempting, but a familiar target may better fund the next breakthrough.

rules.zh: 玩家可以重复处理已经能稳定完成的目标来积累资源，也可以尝试更高门槛的新目标。推进可能解锁更好收益，但耗时、失败或补给消耗会拖慢积累。玩家根据实际表现退回刷取、升级，再次尝试突破。
rules.en: Repeat a reliably completed target to build resources, or attempt a harder new target. Progress can unlock better rewards, but time, failure or supply costs can slow accumulation. Use observed performance to return to farming, upgrade and try again.

loop.zh: 观察单位时间收益与损耗
loop.en: Observe yield and costs over time

loop.zh: 升级后重新判断能否推进

decisions.zh: 能勉强打赢的新敌人，收益是否真的高过快速重复旧敌人？
decisions.en: Does barely beating a new enemy actually earn more than quickly repeating an old one?

decisions.zh: 为了新掉落接受低效率，还是先积累稳定提升再来？
decisions.en: Accept lower efficiency for a new drop or build reliable upgrades first?

effect.zh: 只损失时间便于试探；再损失补给或装备会让准备更重要。
effect.en: Losing only time encourages probing; losing supplies or equipment makes preparation more important.

effect.zh: 同时显示完成时间、掉落和消耗，帮助玩家理解“更难”不一定“更划算”。
effect.en: Showing completion time, drops and consumption helps explain why harder need not be more profitable.

implementation.zh: 玩家可在Farm Mode停留于当前区域重复赚金币，也可开启Progression Mode自动推进，直到遇到无法及时击败的首领。
implementation.en: Farm Mode stays in one zone earning gold; Progression Mode advances through zones until a boss cannot be beaten in time.

observation.zh: 系统参考图：英雄升级、金币和敌人展示推进背景；本条所述的奖励结算与长期变化需结合规则来源阅读。
observation.en: System reference: upgrades, gold and an enemy provide progression context; read the rule source for reward settlement and changes over time.

implementation.zh: 玩家选择怪物区域或地下城持续作战，既可重复熟悉敌人取得材料，也可挑战更难的目标；生存能力和补给会影响能否持续。
implementation.en: Players select combat areas or dungeons, repeating familiar enemies for materials or taking on harder targets; survivability and supplies determine whether the activity can continue.

observation.zh: 系统参考图：战斗、装备、任务与掉落信息同屏显示。
observation.en: System reference: Combat, equipment, task and loot information share the screen. See the linked text source for the rules.

contrast.zh: 点击英雄把刷取与推进直接做成模式切换；梅尔沃通过玩家选择目标区域、装备和补给形成类似循环。
contrast.en: Clicker Heroes exposes a direct farming/progression switch; Melvor creates a similar loop through target-area, equipment and supply choices.

combination.zh: 组合提案：高难目标会更快磨损工具，界面同时显示净收入与维修成本，让返回低难区刷资源成为合理选择。
combination.en: Design proposal: harder targets wear equipment faster; show net earnings and repair costs so returning to an easier target is a meaningful option.

setup.zh: 旧目标每轮掉4币，新目标要3轮才能打倒、掉10币。
setup.en: An old target drops four coins each round; a new one takes three rounds and drops ten.

action.zh: 玩家先刷旧目标3轮，再花积蓄提升攻击。
action.en: Farm the old target for three rounds, then spend the earnings on attack.

result.zh: 升级后新目标只需2轮，其每轮平均收益反而更高。
result.en: After upgrading, the new target takes two rounds, making its average yield higher.

next.zh: 现在转去新目标，下一次卡点再比较。
next.en: Move to the new target and reassess at the next bottleneck.

firstStep.zh: 做两个目标、一个自动处理计时器和一项影响速度的升级。
firstStep.en: Build two targets, one automatic-resolution timer and an upgrade that affects speed.

pitfall.zh: 不要只显示敌人等级；让玩家看到用时与净收益，避免无法判断为什么停滞。
pitfall.en: Show time and net yield rather than only enemy levels, so players can understand a stall.

test.zh: 玩家失败后是否知道该回哪里积累什么，再回来验证？
test.en: After failing, do players know where to gather what they need and then retry?
